verdict.rationale: The only evaluation-related evidence describes webhooks as a way to send completed requests to external systems where responses can be scored. That is a developer building block, not a built-in, configurable LLM-as-a-judge evaluator. Nothing in the pack documents Helicone itself defining judge prompts, judge models or scoring criteria.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can score outputs with configurable LLM-as-a-judge evaluators
